name: Subsystem Relation
description: Z1 is a subsystem of Z2 when both are resultants with nested component vectors and restricted connections. Book “Z = RSY(SCR)” is packaged as IsResultantOf (SZ/IZ/OZ type equalities + dynamics), not bare HEq.

elements.text: Z1 is a subsystem of Z2 via IsResultantOf Z1 SCR1, IsResultantOf Z2 SCR2, injective φ embedding VSCR1 into VSCR2 with matching component state types (IsSubrecipeOf.sz), HEq on components/ports, and CSCR1 ↔ embedded pairs in CSCR2 ∩ subsystem port pairs (textbook (iv)).

fidelity_note: IsResultantOf strengthens HEq packaging so state types are identified with rsy_SZ (required for Ex 5.142).
